title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement: Tow Dispatch Cancellation Hold on Redemption
content:
**Rule.** On redemption of a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement under a notice of intent to tow, a tow dispatch cancellation hold is added to the redemption amount and held as a credit on the agreement, by the distance to the earliest tow date:

| Earliest tow date is | Hold added |
|---|---|
| no more than 7 days away from the handling date (a date already reached included) | $35.00 |
| more than 7 but no more than 14 days away | $15.00 |
| more than 14 days away | nothing |

**Earliest tow date.** The date of the notice of intent to tow of the current delinquency cycle plus the tow wait days of the space class, counted in calendar days:

| Space class | Tow wait after the notice |
|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | 15 days |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 15 days |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 15 days |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 15 days |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 15 days |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | 21 days |

The current delinquency cycle is the one running from the agreement's delinquency date; its notice of intent to tow is the one whose cycle runs from that date.

### Hypothetical cases

- Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft), notice dated 1 October: earliest tow date 16 October. Handling date 3 October: 13 days away, hold $15.00. Handling date 9 October: 7 days away, hold $35.00.
- Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage, notice dated 1 October: earliest tow date 22 October. Handling date 3 October: 19 days away, nothing.
